title: POST submits data
summary: POST sends data to a resource for processing. Many APIs use it to create something, according to that API's contract.
introduction: POST sends data to a resource for processing. Many APIs use it to create something, according to that API's contract. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Never press Send against a live write endpoint merely to see what happens.
